ns2:course.label: Expressive Drawing
ns2:course.description: One of a suite of three drawing courses, this class includes the following drawing concepts: narrative, conceptual, applied, non-objective, format, process, seriality and collage. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: For art and design majors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: For art and design majors only.
